comment: Easy class, but papers/lectures are hard to get through if you have no interest in soc. He's my favorite professor this semester. He has a really animated personality so lectures aren't incredibly boring. Definitely recommend!!!

Papers are really easily graded I got 100s on both of them and I am a science major. Makes his lectures engaging even though it is an entry level class. 2 quizzes that was basically open note. Really caring professor and very inspiring. Recommend you take any class with him!

There are only two quizzes throughout the semester and you are allowed to use one page front and back notes on both of them - making them really easy as long as you have the lecture ppt. All the essays are also simple and graded easy (ps I never get 100 in essays, but I got 2 in his class). This is an easy A class.

TAKE THIS CLASS! He is a great teacher for an intro class. An easy grader, but you have to know the material in order to get a good grade. He is very understanding to conflicts and always answers emails. He makes lectures very engaging and he made the class fun. 10/10
Prof. Steel's class is a good choice for an intro course. He is always well-prepared for the lectures. Tests and papers are easy. He is a really chill grader.

Take this class!! Prof. Steel is lecture heavy, but he comes prepared to class and makes discussions SO engaging. He is very enthusiastic, and it helps students take interest in the class. 2 papers and 2 quizzes in the sem (you can bring a cheat sheet!), and he's a pretty easy grader. He's also VERY understanding about personal conflicts!!

Amazing guy, amazing class. He is extremely well prepared and knows his stuff. Although the class is lecture heavy, he knows how to engage a class. Two quizzes that he allows you to bring a cheat sheet. The papers have clear guidelines, and he gives you all the tools to succeed. One of the best classes I've taken.

Professor Steel was an excellent professor this semester. The assignments were very open-ended which could be frustrating, but he gave VERY good feedback if you asked questions and it ultimately allowed for more creativity which was nice. He is such a nice guy and clearly cares about what he is teaching. I highly recommend taking a class with him.

Steel was an awesome professor. Glad I took his course my first year. You can tell he is passionate about sociology and teaching, and you can tell he cares about the students' well being. Very approachable. You can tell he has a lot of energy based on his pacing lecturing style. Lots of lectures, and few grades, but he's awesome. Chances for e.c.

Prof Steel is very understanding and nice. His class is not difficult and he lets you bring one page of notes to tests. I would take this class again if I could. Sometimes it's lecture heavy but he's passionate and so nice that it doesn't really matter.

Dr. Steel is a good professor, he is good at explaining things. He allows students to use one page of notes for tests and gives sufficient time to work on papers. I would recommend taking his class to learn a lot about sociology. He wants his students to succeed.

Loved his lectures, but a lot of info. He does assign a lot of readings each night, which do not always have to be done because there is no assignment associated with them, and they are really just a starting point for lectures. I wish there were more grades to balance grading, because he does grade quizzes and papers a little harshly.
